rules.accepted_credit_types: Approved by the AMA, AOA, AAFP, AAPA or another entity approved by the board
rules.alternatives: None: proof of current NCCPA certification is required in addition to the 100 hours.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Within the first two years of licensure or before the first renewal: 1.5 h pediatric abusive head trauma and a one-time 1 h course on Alzheimer's and other dementias (PA-program curriculum may count).
rules.audit_note: Certify on the board's Continuing Education Certification Form at renewal; random audits, verification due within 10 days of request. Extension possible for sufficient cause (fee).

topics.who: PAs authorized to prescribe or administer controlled substances: diversion, pain management, addiction disorders, KASPER use (board-approved)
PAs authorized to prescribe buprenorphine products: addiction medicine (within the 100 h)

rules.notes: License valid 2 years. KRS 311.844 (eff. 7/15/2026) also requires 1 h every 3 years on recognition and prevention of pediatric ingestion or inhalation of controlled substances (no matching topic code).
rules.rule_quote: (b) The holder shall provide evidence of completion, during the previous two (2) years, of a minimum of one hundred (100) hours of continuing education…
